name: Dual-stream LSTM/Transformer + IC loss + LGBM ensemble
tagline: Adaptively-gated features feed parallel LSTM and Transformer streams; gated fusion + IC-regularized loss; final score blends with LightGBM.
formula: $$\hat y = w_{\mathrm{nn}}\,\mathrm{zscore}(\hat y_{\mathrm{NN}}) + (1-w_{\mathrm{nn}})\,\mathrm{zscore}(\hat y_{\mathrm{LGBM}})$$ $$\mathcal{L} = \mathrm{MSE}(\hat y_{\mathrm{NN}}, y) - \lambda\,\mathrm{Pearson}(\hat y_{\mathrm{NN}}, y),\;\;\lambda=0.15$$
init_recovers: qlib LSTM baseline if transformer stream and IC term are removed and ensemble_weight=1
diff_from_baseline: Hybrid of LSTM and Transformer baselines plus the LGBM baseline. Inputs are filtered through a sigmoid AdaptiveFeatureGate, projected/LN, then run through both an LSTM (last hidden state) and a TransformerEncoder with learned temporal-attention pooling; softmax-gated fusion produces y_NN. Loss combines MSE with a differentiable Pearson IC regularizer (lambda=0.15). At predict time NN and LightGBM (official Alpha360 hyperparameters) are z-scored and averaged 50/50.

name: GRU + learned-query attention + IC-regularized MSE
tagline: GRU encodes the 60-day sequence; a single learned query attends over time and the head is trained with MSE - 0.3*Pearson IC.
formula: $$\alpha_t = \mathrm{softmax}_t\!\Big(\frac{\langle q, h_t\rangle}{\sqrt{H}}\Big),\;\;c=\sum_t \alpha_t h_t,\;\;\hat y = W_o\,\mathrm{drop}(c)$$ $$\mathcal{L} = \mathrm{MSE}(\hat y, y) - \lambda\,\mathrm{Pearson}(\hat y, y),\;\;\lambda=0.3$$
init_recovers: qlib LSTM baseline at lambda=0 (modulo GRU vs LSTM and attention pool)
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the qlib LSTM baseline with a 2-layer GRU + LayerNorm and inserts a learned-query attention pool over time (replaces last-hidden read-out); training loss is MSE - 0.3 * differentiable Pearson IC. AdamW with weight decay 1e-4 and 100 epochs.

name: 10-seed LightGBM bag + Ridge blend
tagline: Average ten Alpha360 LightGBMs over different seeds and convex-combine with a Ridge(alpha=100) prediction (0.8 LGBM + 0.2 Ridge).
init_recovers: lgbm baseline at n_seeds=1 and Ridge weight 0
diff_from_baseline: Extends the lgbm baseline by bagging 10 LightGBMs with different random seeds (and feature/bagging/drop/data seeds) and convex-combining the average with a Ridge(alpha=100) on the same Alpha360 features. Replaces missing/inf features with 0. NOTE: as written the params dict has a misplaced self.ridge = Ridge(alpha=1000) inside the dict literal, so the file may not import.

name: Cold-init LSTM + Plateau LR (CPU)
tagline: Same LSTM as the qlib LSTM baseline but with Xavier/orthogonal/forget-bias=1 init, AdamW(lr=1e-3, wd=1e-5), ReduceLROnPlateau, 20 epochs, on CPU.

nodes.label: 2-layer LSTM H=64 (Xavier IH / orth HH / forget bias = 1)

key_hyperparams.name: init
key_hyperparams.value: weight_ih: Xavier; weight_hh: orthogonal; forget bias = 1

init_recovers: qlib LSTM baseline at default torch init, Adam (no scheduler), 200 epochs, GPU
diff_from_baseline: Same LSTM architecture as the qlib LSTM baseline but with explicit Xavier/orthogonal/forget-bias=1 LSTM init, ReduceLROnPlateau LR schedule, 20-epoch training with patience=5, batch_size=512, device pinned to CPU, and no AdamW (uses Adam with wd=1e-5). The accompanying yaml edit also drops the RobustZScoreNorm feature processor, leaving only Fillna.

name: LightGBM + cross-sectional z-score features
tagline: Augments each Alpha360 feature with its per-day z-score (720-dim feature vector) and fits LightGBM with magnitude-tilted sample weights.
init_recovers: lgbm baseline if cross-sectional features and sample weights are dropped
diff_from_baseline: Same LightGBM training loop and Alpha360 inputs as the lgbm baseline, but doubles the feature width by concatenating per-day cross-sectional z-scores, sets sample weights to min(1 + |y|/median|y|, 3) to emphasise extreme returns, and retunes hyperparameters (lr=0.05, num_leaves=256, smaller L1/L2, min_child_samples=100). The workflow yaml is unchanged from the LightGBM baseline.
